contract: Preallocated private unmodified row-major inputs, two distinct activation/output pairs and one shared immutable weight matrix. GPU command time per call; allocation, initial uploads, loading and verification excluded. Every round checks both complete outputs, suffix guards and both inputs. Exact dyadic screening only, not managed throughput or full arbitrary-float qualification. Baseline selects production hardware block32/block64/register/tiled policy. No packing, vendor library or relaxed arithmetic.
